start.content: It is dangerous to speak here. The council chamber was closed to many of us tonight, but the decision was made before the candles were lit. I have the means to secure the remains from the governor's staff, but it requires using up all my political leverage. Conscience is an expensive thing to buy back when you have kept silent for too long.

choices.text: Will the rest of the Sanhedrin oppose your request to Pilate?

council.content: They want the matter forgotten. A public tomb means a public memory. They will not be pleased, but the Roman law allows for family burial petitions. -> closing

tomb.content: I have a new vault cut out of the bedrock near the execution hill. It is secure, clean, and empty. -> closing
